subject.title: Improve doctor/gateway diagnostics clarity for mixed LaunchAgent/runtime states

question: What final doctor diagnosis taxonomy and recovery-order output should OpenClaw standardize for mixed LaunchAgent, runtime, RPC, service-drift, and channel-conflict states?
rationale: Current main already collects many of the individual facts, but the public diagnosis wording, probable-cause precedence, and optional JSON diagnosis shape are maintainer UX decisions.

options.title: Compose final doctor verdict
options.body: Add a final healthy/degraded/down diagnosis with probable causes and ordered next steps, reusing existing service, runtime, RPC, and channel facts.

options.title: Keep independent panels
options.body: Leave current doctor output as separate panels and improve only individual messages as specific transcripts are reproduced.

options.title: Define JSON diagnosis first
options.body: Introduce a structured diagnosis object before changing user-facing prose, then render the final panel from that object later.

recommendation.title: Compose final doctor verdict
recommendation.body: Add a final healthy/degraded/down diagnosis with probable causes and ordered next steps, reusing existing service, runtime, RPC, and channel facts.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is repeated work on doctor orchestration and gateway service recovery paths.
